# Evidence template

```text
# Topic — YYYY-MM-DD
Task, FR/D/AC/G/F links:
Purpose and exact scope:
Revision/dirty state; source revisions if documentation:
Environment / tools / browser / OS / assistive tech:
Target / actor scopes / fixture seed / workload / sample count:
Actual versus mocked/substituted dependencies:
Commands/method and observed result (including failures):
Sanitized durable artifact paths / hashes, if available:
Finding and correction / review disposition:
Not run / unavailable / uncertainties / what is not proven:
Remaining gates and next action:
```

Never copy private records, raw sensitive queries/errors, auth state, credentials
or production data into evidence. Record paths to durable sanitized artifacts,
not temporary machine-local files as if they were committed proof.
